bifrost: springboard/src/shell/diag.rs, springboard/src/shell/diagnostics_page.rs, springboard/src/bare/crashlog.rs, springboard/src/bare/heartbeat.rs, springboard/src/bare/jank.rs, springboard/core/src/host.rs, springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs, springboard/core/src/log.rs, springboard/sdk/src/log.rs
summary: BifrOSt records crashes, UI stalls and slow frames at system level and shows them to the user in Settings and Console, and it can share them with the developer. No app receives a metric report or a diagnostic report through an SDK API, so MetricKit's app-facing reporting (MXMetricManager, MetricReport, DiagnosticReport delivery) has no counterpart; the system-side capture is partly there. Refreshed 2026-10-17: Signposts are built: springboard/sdk/src/signpost.rs (Signposter, tests signpost::tests) and springboard/core/src/signpost.rs, and the Console app has a signposts view (springboard/apps/console-desktop/src/signposts.rs), so that gap is closed.

features.feature: Daily metric reports to the app (MXMetricManager, MetricReport)
features.apple: MXMetricManager, MetricReport (async sequences, once per day, previous 24 h)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metrickit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No SDK type delivers a daily report to an app. Host counters are read by the shell for its own menu extras and by ProcessInfo; no report is produced. Built 2026-10-17: Built 2026-10-17: the shell feeds per-app totals (launch, foreground, close, normal ending) and runs the daily schedule for subscribed apps, which get a didReceiveDailyReport event and can read their archive (springboard/src/shell/services/metric_reports.rs, service metrics; the model moved to core/src/daily_metric_report.rs with payload_json and payload_from_json); tests metric_reports::tests and daily_metric_report tests. Gaps: background time is not tracked, first draw is not hooked, and the SDK does not yet wrap the metrics service. Not run: lead runs the tests.

The shell writes crash.log (panics and watchdog exits, rotated at 256 KB) and lists entries under Settings > Privacy > Analytics & Diagnostics. Panic and stall records of that text are read into typed reports, tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-05.rs. Gap: the shell does not deliver a report to an app when it is written, and apps cannot read the shell's log file. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metrickit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Each crash is one line: timestamp, thread, panic location and message (diag.rs CrashEntry, signature). No structured call-stack tree is exposed to any app. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Hang diagnostics and UI stall detection (HangDiagnostic, HangTimeMetric)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/diagnostic_report.rs (DiagnosticKind::Stall, longest_stall); springboard/src/bare/heartbeat.rs (STALL_MS 20 s, exit status 5); wired: springboard/apps/console-desktop/src/diagnostics.rs (HangSource, hang_rows)
features.note: The shell's frozen-UI watcher appends a stall line to crash.log and exits after 20 s without a beat. Each stall record carries the whole seconds logged, and longest_stall gives the longest one; both are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-05.rs. Gap: the watcher covers the shell loop only, there is no hang duration histogram, and no callback reaches an app. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Built 2026-10-17: stall_histogram in sdk diagnostic_report (buckets 0-5, 5-10, 10-30, 30-60 and 60 s or more); tests diagnostic_report::tests. No callback reaches an app yet.

features.feature: Animation hitch and slow-frame measurement (HitchTimeMetric, HitchTimeRatio)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metrickit, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Frame budget is classified at 16.7 ms and 33 ms and written to perf.log, rate-limited to 20 lines per second. The data stays in the shell; there is no per-app hitch metric.

features.feature: CPU and memory metrics (CPUTimeMetric, PeakMemoryMetric, SuspendedMemoryMetric)
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/host.rs (per-process memory and CPU counters from /proc), springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. An app can read its own memory and CPU counters through ProcessInfo at the moment of the call. No peak or suspended-memory statistics are kept, and no instruction counts exist.

features.feature: Memory and CPU exception diagnostics (MemoryExceptionDiagnostic, CPUExceptionDiagnostic)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 4 (theme-20, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. An app killed for memory or CPU limits is not recorded as a diagnostic event; only panics and watchdog exits are.

features.feature: Time-in-use metrics (foreground, background, audio, location time)
features.apple: TotalForegroundTimeMetric, TotalBackgroundTimeMetric, TotalBackgroundAudioTimeMetric, TotalBackgroundLocationTimeMetric, LocationActivityTimeMetric, CellularConditionTimeMetric
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (w3-metrickit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell knows when each app is foreground or backgrounded but keeps no per-app time totals and reports none.

features.feature: Launch, resume and extended launch timing (TimeToFirstDrawMetric, ApplicationResumeTimeMetric, ExtendedLaunchMetric)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (w3-metrickit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No time-to-first-draw or resume timing is measured per app and delivered to it.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (w3-metrickit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The shell writes a last_exit file for the watchdog. Termination is not counted by category and not reported to apps.

features.feature: Network data metrics (Wi-Fi and cellular upload and download)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 5 (theme-18, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The network daemon does not attribute byte counts to apps and no per-app totals exist.

features.feature: Disk write and storage metrics (LogicalDiskWritesMetric, TotalFileSizeMetric, DiskWriteExceptionDiagnostic)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 5 (w5-metrickit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No per-app write totals or file-size attribution, and no disk-write exception path.

features.feature: GPU and Metal frame metrics (GPUTimeMetric, MetalFrameRateMetric)
features.note: Recorder keeps the last N presented frames of an app with GPU time per frame, mean and max GPU time, frame rate and dropped frames against the refresh period (frame_metrics::Recorder, Summary). The caller supplies the GPU time and presentation time; the presenter does not feed it yet, and no app reaches it, so per-layer measurement and pixel luminance remain missing. Built on parity/team-a-04; not yet verified on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: Built 2026-10-17: the presenter feeds every drawn surface's frame figures (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs: the pass time, measured as the wait for the GPU in draw, and the finish instant on the presenter clock, recorded with frame_metrics::Recorder over 120 frames at 60 Hz until the shell sets the refresh); Presenter::frame_summary reads them. Tests frame_feed_tests::presented_passes_feed_the_surface_summary_and_a_backwards_frame_is_dropped. Gaps: no app reaches the summary yet, the refresh period is fixed, and per-layer and luminance metrics are missing. Not run: lead runs the tests.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-25, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Unified logging exists, but no signposter. docs/bifrost-ui.md (Unified Logging gaps) and docs/milestone-unified-logging.md list signposts and spin reports as planned work.

features.feature: Reading own log entries that reports are built from (LogStore)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. An app can read its own process entries in memory. The journal is readable only by apps with the log-store entitlement. This is not a MetricKit substitute.

features.apple: Feedback and diagnostic submission in Settings (MetricKit reports are read by the app, not shared by the system)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/diag.rs (bundle, upload_url, post), springboard/src/shell/diagnostics_page.rs (Share with Developer)
features.note: The shell uploads a bundle of build stamp, crash.log, heartbeat and perf files to the developer update server only when the user presses Share with Developer. Apps have no SDK call for it on purpose: an app upload would send its own data without the user choosing it, so the blocker is that consent rule, not a missing API.

gaps: No app-facing report API: no MXMetricManager equivalent delivers daily metric reports or diagnostic reports to an app.
No per-app metric collection beyond ProcessInfo counters: time-in-use, launch and resume timing, network, disk and GPU totals are not kept per app (frame_metrics has no caller yet).
Crash and hang records are one-line log entries; the call-stack tree type exists (springboard/sdk/src/call_stack_tree.rs, tests call_stack_tree::tests) but no crash or hang record fills it.
No exception diagnostics for memory or CPU limit kills, and no termination counts by category.
No per-process energy impact or pixel luminance metric.
